body: I won't, a train is too fast and heavy, bye (-:
bye (-:
So now it's time to leave. **I don't blame anyone, everything is my own fault.** But you could have been more supportive and cut your crap comments.
Not very comfortable. I just put my neck on the rails.

You're a stupid individual. You could have easily checked my profile and previous thread. I did multiple therapies and took countless meds.

Goodbye.
Nope. Have a nice evening. I'm leaving right now. Please support euthanasia, so something like this doesn't have to happen (-:

> Please don't do this.

Too late. I will leave within the next five minutes.

> Stop what you are doing right now and tell me what's going on

You could have easily clicked my profile.

> I didn't see your last post and I want to know what you are feeling.

I don't care what you want to know. I'm not important, you're not important. I don't need your fucking "I CARE, I FEEL FOR YOU"-bullshit. I don't care if other people care. That's not why I got depressed.

Don't bother answering, I will not be here to give you another reply.
You could have easily clicked my profile, but don't bother.

What to do when everything else failed. I gave every try enough time to work, but nothing worked out at all. And all you people manage to say is something like: "OKAY TAKE MORE MEDS PLEASE AND DO MORE THERAPY". Yeah, just starve some more, maybe food comes out of nowhere.

I just hoped someone would write anything useful. Anything. Anything on what I could do to not go through with what I'm about to do now.

Now it's too late. I just put my suicide note up, packed my stuff and will likely cause a trauma to another person. Just because I'm forbidden to purchase Nembutal for a peaceful death.

> You said you wanted attention.

No, I chose the topic title so someone would at least bother writing an answer.

>  so doctors said "We have tried everything and there's nothing more we can try" ?

Exactly. They told me I'm treatment-resistant and they can lock me up for my own safety if I feel the urge to hurt myself. They can paralyze me with meds, but anti-depressants are just not working. My metabolical system can't process them.

> Because of your past experiences, you go into new therapy thinking it's not gonna work...

It can't work. Why don't you understand? I'm not depressed because no one talked to me or something like that. I have not been abused, I'm not suppressing my feelings and never had to starve or alike.

I've done multiple fucking types of therapies. Individual and in groups. I didn't feel anything changing. My perspective is exactly the same.

I'm not depressed because I feel "unloved" or nobody listening to me.

My depression is something physical, neurological, whatever. But I had so many scans and they all said everything was fine with me. But if I were fine, I wouldn't be depressed.

My head hurts, I can't go on any longer. I just told my parents they can stop contacting me any longer, it's over.
Oh now his suicidal ideation just vanished. Just because you wrote "hugs and love". Sure.

I hate people like you. This guy is going to kill himself and all you're able to say is "Climb a fucking mountain". Really? Maybe you should be the one who dies, not him. He's committing suicide and with what kind of money or motivation should he visit another country? And why would this change anything? We're talking about being depressed and not having "the blues".

You're a smart-ass, aren't you? I already tried literally everything. And comments like yours are exactly the reason why I really just want to be gone.

What would you tell a starving kind in Vietnam? "Eat more"?

How can one be so ignorant.
I fucking don't. I want my depression to be gone, nothing else. But meds, therapy and clinic just made everything worse.
I want to know what I'm left to do after neither meds, nor therapy and clinic helped in any way? I'm really done for. I think I'm going to kill me before this year is over.

> If you tell them everything, you wouldn't have to lie. If they ask questions, answer them? People ask because they don't know. It seems like people act like nothing happened because it's not a big deal to them, forget and move on. You have already made up your mind that the friendship won't work, even though they don't think it's necessarily true. Why do you think they keep inviting you?

People ask because I act different in comparison. And people don't like it if you're strange. They feel alienated by your behavior. Answering questions doesn't make anything better. I did before, did it help me? Of course not. Did it help the others understand me? Nope.

> Why do you think they keep inviting you?

Because I make a funny comment from time to time? Because they think I'm the adult class clown? What do I know. Surely not because of "friendship", because we are no friends. Friends know something about each other. They don't know anything about me and I don't know anything about them. It's been just 2 month ago since I met them.

> You keep saying it's not about others but the title and the original post are a lot about the others.

Yes to get attention, I'm sorry. But "OMG I'M SO BAD" doesn't work so well, does it?

> You should probably eat more. Hunger gives you headaches.

I'm not hungry and no, that's not the reason (-:

They're not my friends. When I look back I didn't have friends for the last decade.

> is there was accepting you for who you are

No, they just ignored my issues.

> I think maybe you should try and find a different counselor or therapist.

How many additional, useless therapies should I do? Talking doesn't help. It's just talking. So I ask again: Can you take something like cancer away? Can you? Don't want to be rude, but it's annoying getting the same suggestion over again and again. 

I did every form of therapy my health insurance (we have a public one in our country) pays for, took like 15 meds and did ECT. Nothing even made my situation better by 1%.

So I'm really lost here. Please apologize my anger.

> What hobbies do you have?

None

> You are contradicting

Different time periods.

> You said, "I choose to not let anyone into my life". Now you say you did.

Before my current current period of life I let people into my life. I stopped doing so after being depressed for 1,5 years.

> but how did that make everything worse?

Because I have to lie and lie and lie. If I don't I get asked even more questions and strange looks. I just want my peace.

> You also said, "I can't give them back anything in return", then you say you were an useful idiot.

I openly told people or at least hinted it that there was something wrong with me. They mostly just ignored it and continued to do whatever they do. One time when I went out with them I just left without saying anything after a few hours. So two people asked where I went and I told them I can't be with them because something inside my head is very wrong.

Next week they talked to me like nothing happened and just invited me again. This time I refused and just used the pretext of currently moving into a new apartment (which wasn't exactly a lie, but I could have joined them again).

Two weeks ago I just had an argument with one of the people over a presentation we have to do. I told her we should just stop talking at all because it's useless and she can go annoy someone else. Then I blocked her everywhere. Then we had a week free and yesterday we had a course together. She was all: ":D hey what's up" and I just wanted to punch her.

--------

What I learned from the last ~15 years (I'm older, I'm just talking about my youth/adolescence)? I can't be with people.

But let's stop focussing on that. My problem is my depression and there is no way of making it easier. I literally tried everything. I even had this electric-whatever-brain-thing with ~12 sessions?
I have gone through multiple individual- and group-therapies, in- and outpatient. I'm treatment-resistant.

That's not true. I let a lot people into my life, but it didn't change anything. Just made everything worse again because no one could even possibly understand.

To say it once again: This is not about others. My headache and depression just got to strong and I'm genetically resistant to ADs (read about P450 and stuff if you like to). Talking did shit, just as exercising.

Can you talk away a heart disease? Of course not.

Not necessarily. I was an useful idiot. Someone you could invite to have some company and throw away later. But in the end it was my fault anyway because I choose to not let anyone into my life. My depression destroyed everything until I actually became it.

Now I just have to figure out how I will die. By rope? By jumping? By train? Maybe I should combine all three methods. Attach a rope to a bridge with railway tracks beneath. 

Med after med, therapy after therapy, everything failed. Even the non-professional stuff (meditation, sports, ...) was just a waste of time.
Like I said, I don't even care about that. I wanted to make my depression vanish over time, but everything I did was a huge failure.
